text:
```artifact
@start
initial state: OFF
mode pressure_control

@event pressure_fall_start
guard pressure_fall_start_condition
transition pressure_fall

@event pressure_fall_end
guard pressure_fall_end_condition
transition pressure_control

@mode pressure_control
initial state: IDLE

@event pressure_command
guard pressure_command_condition
transition SET_POINT

@event pressure_setpoint_reached
guard pressure_setpoint_reached_condition
transition IDLE

@end
```
